messages:
Megan (PM): quick sync — we need to align on long-term multi-region safety cushions + tenant prioritization flows. customers keep asking for deterministic fallbacks for cross-region spikes :thinking_face:
Dmitri (Infra): +1. we should define clear "priority bands" (gold/silver/bronze) that map to route preferences, burst capacity, and quarantine rules. simple mapping first, refine later
Raj (SRE): agree. also need hard limits for eviction and throttling to avoid noisy-tenant blast windows. SLOs must be explicit per band.
Elaine (Product Arch): proposal: launch criteria = (1) per-band SLA docs, (2) routing policy DSL v1, (3) telemetry signals + rollout playbook. canary must include cross-region failure simulations.
Sasha (Eng): technical constraints: routing DSL requires per-request metadata (region_pref, tenant_priority, regulatory_tag). how heavy is that on the proxy path? Dmitri?
Dmitri (Infra): we can piggyback on existing headers. cost: ~0.5-1% latency on median p95 if we keep decisions in-edge router. bigger cost is state management for affinity windows.
Megan (PM): customers care most about predictability and isolation during peak. prioritize: 1) deterministic failover order 2) tenant quarantine 3) cost controls. does that ordering sound right?
Elaine (Product Arch): yes. add: exportable contract for customers (what we guarantee per band). product needs explicit failure modes documented.
Raj (SRE): telemetry ask: we need per-tenant sliding-window token/cost metrics + cross-region retry traces. telemetry-bot: will generate an event schema draft tomorrow.
telemetry-bot: draft schema created: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/schemas/priority-band-v1 (will post PR) :white_check_mark:
Sasha (Eng): implementation notes: MVP plan — routing decision is read-only map + fallback list. no live learning. durability only for affinity keys (redis ttl).
Megan (PM): launch gating checklist (MVP):
- policies DSL v1 implemented and documented
- SLA contracts + customer-facing matrix
- telemetry events + alerting for cross-region eviction
- canary run with 2 customers on Dedicated
- run chaos test: simulate region ejection for 15m
If all green -> beta rollout to opt-in orgs.
Dmitri (Infra): deps: billing needs to map priority bands to charges (or at least labels), infra provisioning for reserved burst capacity, and automation for forced-evict flows. I'll open infra tickets.
Elaine (Product Arch): risk note: regulatory_tag could force non-fallback behaviour. must be first-class in policy.
Megan (PM): asks for prioritization decision: is this Q3 initiative or Q4? product leaning Q3 for Beta. engineering capacity?
Sasha (Eng): we can do a phased Q3 if we reuse existing routing framework; full automation and quota mapping likely Q4.
Raj (SRE): SRE ops runbook + runbook drills need to be scheduled during canary. add on-call checklist.
Megan (PM): ok — action items:
- Dmitri: infra tickets + capacity estimate (by EOD Fri)
- Raj: draft runbook + SLO matrix (end of week)
- Elaine: policy DSL sketch + customer contract template (Wed)
- Sasha: implementation plan + rough ETA (Mon)
- telemetry-bot: PR for schema (tomorrow)
I'll sync with sales on customer candidates for canary.
Dmitri (Infra): noted. opening ticket: INF-17291 "priority-band capacity + eviction automation"
Sasha (Eng): will post a short RFC early next week.
Megan (PM): thanks — feel free to drop short comments in-thread. we should avoid big design meetings until RFC lands. :rocket:
